title: Vampire Vape Cherry Tree 10ml E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Cherry Tree E-Liquid is a juicy sweet and irresistibly tangy e-juice that captures the rich flavour of ripe cherries to perfection. It’s far fruitier than many candy-tasting cherry flavoured w-liquids out there. This Cherry Tree E-Liquid offers the real, authentic taste of cherries we all know and love. So, if you are a fan of sweet and juicy Cherries don’t hesitate to grab a bottle or two. You won’t be disappointed! This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage , sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
